Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Shailesh Singh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Session Case No.696 of 2021 (State v. Anoop Sharma alias Mahesh and others) arising out of Case Crime No.168 of 2021 at Police Station-Ghatampur, District-Kanpur Nagar under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
The applicant is in jail since 26.04.2021.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 21.10.2021.

The following arguments made by Shri Shailesh Singh Yadav, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Anoop Sharma Alias Mahesh vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5776101/

sentences.text: 1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
3. The deceased was a sensitive lady who was prone to extreme reactions even over trivial issues.
4. On the fateful day, after a minor argument she flew into a fit of rage and committed suicide by hanging.

5. The postmortem report opines that:
(i). The cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.
(ii).No abnormality was detected in the hyoid bone.
(iii).
Ligature marks are referenced which are consistent with the hanging.
6. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
7. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Anoop Sharma Alias Mahesh be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Anoop Sharma Alias Mahesh vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5776101/
